intro.background: EN71是欧盟玩具安全标准，也是儿童家具和教玩具最常被问的认证。主要部分：EN71-1机械物理性能、EN71-2阻燃性能、EN71-3特定元素迁移（8种重金属）。欧洲客户买任何儿童产品都要EN71报告。报告通常由TUV、SGS、INTERTEK出具。
intro.desc: 掌握EN71标准的核心内容和英语沟通表达。

oneLiner.en: EN71 is the European Bible for toy safety — if your product is for children, you cannot skip it.
oneLiner.cn: EN71是欧洲玩具安全圣经——儿童产品绕不开。

vocab.ex: Lead migration must be below the limit.
Lead, cadmium and chromium are heavy metals.
Small parts are a choking hazard for under 3.
vocab.exCn: 小零件对3岁以下有窒息风险。

vocab.ex: We have the EN71 test report from TUV.
CE marking is mandatory for the EU.

mistakes.right: Our toys comply with EN71-1, EN71-2 and EN71-3, tested by TUV.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说安全。客户要具体标准号和机构。

basic.en: We have the EN71-3 heavy metal report.
The report is issued by TUV.
CE marking is on all products.
We can send the test report to you.
basic.cn: 我们可以把测试报告发给您。

basic.en: The report is valid for 5 years.

advanced.en: Our complete EN71 package includes EN71-1 mechanical, EN71-2 flammability and EN71-3 heavy metal migration, all tested by TUV Rheinland.
advanced.cn: 我们完整EN71包包括EN71-1机械、EN71-2阻燃、EN71-3重金属迁移，全部TUV莱茵出具。

advanced.en: All small parts are fixed and edges are rounded per EN71-1 to eliminate choking and sharp-edge hazards.
advanced.cn: 所有小零件固定，边缘倒圆，符合EN71-1，消除窒息和锐利风险。
advanced.from: CE marking is on all products.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Do your products have EN71 certification?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, our products are fully tested to EN71-1, EN71-2 and EN71-3 by TUV Rheinland.
lines.cn: 有的。我们产品经TUV莱茵全项测试EN71-1、EN71-2、EN71-3。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Can you send me the report before we order?
lines.cn: 下单前能发报告给我吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Of course. I will send the test report and CE Declaration of Conformity to your email within one hour.
lines.cn: 当然。我一小时内把测试报告和CE符合性声明发到您邮箱。

fillBlank.q: CE ____ is mandatory in the EU.

scenario.q: A German client asks if your tables have EN71 certification. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: Yes, our tables comply with EN71-1, EN71-2 and EN71-3, tested by TUV Rheinland. The report is valid for 5 years. I can also provide the CE DoC. Shall I send both to your email?
scenario.cn: 是的，我们的桌子符合EN71-1/2/3，TUV莱茵出具，5年有效。还可提供CE DoC。要我把两份文件发到您邮箱吗？

culture.title: 认证是敲门砖
culture.content: 欧洲客户第一次问的不是价格，是认证。没有EN71/CE，连报价机会都没有。报告要英文版本，盖CMA/CNAS/ILAC章，中文报告老外不认。

rounds.ai: Do your products have EN71 certification?
Can you send the report before we order?
Is the report valid in Germany?
rounds.hint: EN71是欧盟标准，全欧盟通用。
